items.title: Correct requirements NAV decision-document count
items.context: Codex CLI and Claude CLI audits found docs/requirements/NAV.md declares 37 files while decisions currently has 38 markdown files and 38 NAV decision links. Fix the count only.
items.userSees: User sees docs/requirements/NAV.md declare 38 decision files, matching the 38 linked decision docs in docs/requirements/decisions.

happy.desc: docs/requirements/NAV.md declared file count equals the actual number of decision markdown files.

edge.desc: NAV decision link count equals the actual decision markdown file count after the edit.

adversarial.desc: The NAV fix does not add or remove unrelated decision links or change non-count catalog content.

items.title: Align lifecycle-memory migration target with split destination guidance
items.context: Claude host-neutral audit found root-document-migration-guide.md lists only dev-memory.md for Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md, while the execution solution says the content belongs across dev-memory.md and lifecycle-artifact-scope.md. Align the table target without changing broader policy.
items.userSees: User sees the lifecycle-memory migration row point to both dev-memory.md and lifecycle-artifact-scope.md, matching the execution solution split.

happy.desc: The Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md row names both target homes from the execution solution.

edge.desc: The migration guide and execution solution agree on the split destination for lifecycle-memory content.

adversarial.desc: The edit does not add host-specific migration claims or expand the root cleanup policy.
